title: Resolve same-name eligible sources deterministically to the newest ACCEPTED producer
required_tests: src/__tests__/pair-hotfix-a-cross-mission-input.test.ts#consume binds the NEWEST accepted same-name source deterministically
src/__tests__/pair-hotfix-a-cross-mission-input.test.ts#winner is pinned + replay-identical — drift would fail the re-proof
src/__tests__/pair-hotfix-a-cross-mission-input.test.ts#same-name sources (two artifact ids) → LATEST_ACCEPTED wins, pinned
description: BASE 43de5e4. Live repro: after EXTERNAL_INPUT_AWARENESS (PR #127) let the json_transfer mission commit and produce journal.html v2, the acceptance_verification planner legitimately consumed journal.html and the pool canonicalizer failed FAIL_CLOSED_PLAN_DATAFLOW_AMBIGUOUS_SOURCE — two ACCEPTED sibling artifacts now share the name (missions MSN_01M549VP v1, MSN_01M54FTK v2). A refine-in-place pipeline necessarily produces same-name artifacts under successive sibling missions; hard ambiguity rejection made every downstream verifier unplannable. Fix: bindPlanExternalInputs resolves multiple same-name eligible sources to the NEWEST ACCEPTED producer — total-order deterministic via source_created_at (artifact row created_at, new optional field on ExternalInputArtifactSource populated at eligibility emission) with artifact_id tiebreak. Fail-closed preserved: the stamp pins artifact_id + sha256, so a newer sibling artifact landing between plan and commit shifts the winner and the replayed ledger drifts → FAIL_CLOSED_PLAN_DATAFLOW_SOURCE_BINDING (never a silent re-pin); zero-match consumes still fail UNBOUND_INPUT; scope/lineage checks unchanged. Planner prompt block notes the semantics: same logical name → binds the newest listed version. B2 contract test rewritten from ambiguous-fails to latest-wins-pinned; L1-L3 cover winner selection, pinned replay identity, and created_at ordering (not emission order).
